type: type-104 placement whose +0xA8 behaviour script is PushBlock_Template.ai (0x20B6D8, 1415 instructions: "Minion Locked State Params", "Current Track", "Distance to Waypoint", "Assign Track Toggle", "Track_Switches", sets "Push_Blocks"/"Canons")
structure: Push blocks are track-bound gameplay elements: relocating one away from its track/waypoints freezes the level at start

location.offset: PushBlock_Template.ai script record 0x20B6D8 (shared by Push_Block_Template(1) 0x232258 and (2) 0x20B598, +0xF0 of the type-111 wrapper = +0xA8 of the type-104 record); freezes reproduced with copies positioned at (85.5, 10, 42) on the start island

meaning: Not every placement can be moved or duplicated freely: a push block's STARTUP logic resolves its track, waypoints and switches; a copy dropped on the start island with no track nearby froze the game in-game at the beginning of the opening cutscene in both attempts, whatever the replacement variables (cross-script/cross-class in G2, same script/class/size with the slot's own script and companion kept in G2b). Plants (no behaviour script dependencies) never froze. For the editor: props without a behaviour script (or with self-contained ones) are safe to move/duplicate; track-bound gameplay elements must keep their track context. A control run (in-place move of PushBlock_Mabu to the same spot, no replacement) would turn this into CONFIRMED.

evidence.summary: G2: Push_Block_Template(1) copied over CS_Closing01a at (85.5, 10, 42): froze in-game during the opening cutscene
G2b: Push_Block_Template(2) copied over PushBlock_Mabu (same script, class, size; slot name/script/companion kept) at (85.5, 10, 42): froze at the same moment. Replacement variables excluded

PushBlock_Template.ai STARTUP creates track/waypoint/switch variables ("Current Track", "Distance to Waypoint", "Assign Track Toggle", "Track_Switches"): the element depends on level context that the start island does not provide
